sources.snippet: Agent memory you can read, search, and git diff. memweave is a zero-infrastructure, async-first Python library that gives AI agents persistent, searchable memory — stored as plain Markdown files and indexed by SQLite. No external services. No black-box databases. Every memory is a file you can open, edit, grep, and version-control.
